instance.name: The Venomous Abyss
instance.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.

content.overview:
The spirit of Malacrass will not release his grip on Zul'jan so easily. At the Coiled Altar, the shaman commands the warrior to enact the final ritual to unleash Ula'tek on the Amani--for revenge, and to gain their promised reward.

A mutated Zul'jan unleashes his new power by [spell=1282403] within The Coiled Altar. He wields twin axes that [spell=1299680] players and destroy Coalesced Venom.
Upon Zul'jan's defeat, Malacrass joins the fray. Malacrass haunts players with [spell=1285643], creating Manifestations of Dread as it resolves. His casts of [spell=1286620] hurt players and destroy any Manifestations of Dread in its blast.
Upon defeat, Malacrass begins a ritual of [spell=1304032] to revive Zul'jan as his puppet, and claim what is rightfully his.
